steps.title: Make a developer key in Canvas
Add a Cogniate course in Canvas

manual.label: Developer key
manual.help: Paste the developer key JSON into {LMS}. Then enter the Client ID and the Deployment ID.

dynamic.label: Dynamic Registration
dynamic.help: Copy one registration URL into {LMS}. Cogniate gets the Client ID and the Deployment ID.

registration.title: Register Cogniate in {LMS}
instructions: Copy the registration URL. If there is no URL, or the URL expired, select Get registration URL.
In {LMS}, open Admin, select your account, then open Developer Keys.
Select + Developer Key, then + LTI Registration. Paste the registration URL and complete the steps in {LMS}.
Come back to this page. When {LMS} sends the registration, the next step shows the Client ID and the Deployment ID.

dynamic.registered: {LMS} sent the registration. The registration URL is not necessary now. In the next step, check the Client ID and the Deployment ID. Then enter the approval code from your Cogniate operator and select Save.
dynamic.waiting: Finish the registration in {LMS}. Then this page shows the values to check.
